method.observation: 1-km HYRAS area mean for Germany and the 16 federal states
method.forecast: Open-Meteo ensemble daily 2 m temperature averaged across deterministic support points within each region
method.support_point_note: Forecast area means are a support-point approximation; observations/climatology are exact HYRAS grid-area means.
method.anomaly: Running-period mean minus 1991-2020 running-period daily climatology for the same date.
